column1: 1. What information regarding the club administration is most important to consolidate?
Date: Sponsorship information - help with how to reach out and everything around that , sponsorships early, transportation information, history of club costs - estimates, budgetting help, registration for comp, passwords and logins, timeline
Participant Count: Event organization - information about room booking, information regarding mcmaster interworking, booking rooms really in advanced, timeline for the year (necessary to have in the summer already)

column1: 2. When you first became an executive, what were your largest difficulties?
Date: time and event management, deadlines among execs, how to split up work with the executives, calendars built in to app, running tasks, deadlines, exec timeline stuff,  note storage, hub for cochairs, ticket assigning tasks, pulling into external calendars.
Participant Count: Knowing how to approach event organization, how to specify event breakdown - structures the team timeline, checkins, milestones and all that determines team workload, food information, consolidation of past costs, how to support the increased number of people

column1: 3. How would you like to see the software sub team integrated into the club administration?
Date: Full exec integration, need hands on, involved as other execs, need to be in the loop
Participant Count: Involved in the meetings, a leader and sub-teams, proper integration
